Python through transport data from the first cell.

::: {.cwai-grid}
::: {.cwai-card}
## What this stage covers

Variables, types, collections, loops, conditionals and functions, then modules,
imports and `pandas`.
:::

::: {.cwai-card}
## What you will be able to do

Read a traceback, write an `assert`, use the debugger and run `pytest`.
Engineering practice is part of the work from the start, not an advanced topic
kept for later.
:::

::: {.cwai-card}
## The data you will use

STATS19 road collisions for one area over a few years. The task is to read it,
clean it and distrust it.
:::
:::
